title: Registry password stored in the client configuration
description: .npmrc declares a registry password written directly into the checked-in client configuration. The credential is readable by everyone who can read the repository or a build log that echoes the file, and it cannot be scoped or expired like a token.
remediation: Use a scoped automation token read from the environment, and rotate the password.
limitation: It matches a registry password written directly into the checked-in client configuration in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
